"""One read-only deterministic counterexample; no real process or signal."""
from pathlib import Path
from contextlib import contextmanager
from types import SimpleNamespace
from unittest import mock
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import sys
import tempfile

ROOT = Path("/workspace/scratch/d417066aafa8")
SOURCE = ROOT / "agent-dev-kit/tests/test_skill_command_examples.py"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
EXPECTED = "2be3cbba83ee965bdba635fc5e5d30263e6ecce7f694a1e9c75833b8a39be295"
sha = hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha == EXPECTED
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("reviewed_snapshot", SOURCE)
module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(module)
result = {"started_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), "candidate": "64d120ebcbc5d77fd90af99bac2bb9f4f3a13682",
          "source_sha256": sha, "scope": "Fixed-clock fake-proc cursor boundary; no real process, Ninja, ADC, full, CI or signal"}
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=OUT, prefix="counter-proc-") as name:
    root = Path(name)
    own = root / "9000"
    own.mkdir()
    (own / "stat").write_text("9000 (owned-live) S 1 9000 9000 0 0 0 0 0 0 0 7 8 0 0 0 0 0 0 99\n")
    (own / "wchan").write_text("synthetic_wait")
    yielded = []
    opens = []
    closes = []
    @contextmanager
    def scan(path):
        assert path == root
        opens.append(str(path))
        def entries():
            for index in range(255):
                yielded.append("unrelated-" + str(index))
                yield SimpleNamespace(name="unrelated-" + str(index), path=str(root / ("unrelated-" + str(index))))
            yielded.append("9000")
            yield SimpleNamespace(name="9000", path=str(own))
        try:
            yield entries()
        finally:
            closes.append(str(path))
    state = {"priority_done": True}
    with mock.patch("os.scandir", side_effect=scan), mock.patch("time.monotonic", return_value=100), \
            mock.patch.object(module, "process_status", wraps=module.process_status) as status:
        first = module.owned_process_snapshot(9000, 101, proc_root=root, scan_state=state)
        after_first = {"advanced": state.get("advanced"), "exhausted": state.get("exhausted", False)}
        second = module.owned_process_snapshot(9000, 101, proc_root=root, scan_state=state)
        after_second = {"advanced": state.get("advanced"), "exhausted": state.get("exhausted", False)}
        module.close_owned_scan(state)
        state["exhausted"] = False
        third = module.owned_process_snapshot(9000, 101, proc_root=root, scan_state=state)
        fourth = module.owned_process_snapshot(9000, 101, proc_root=root, scan_state=state)
        module.close_owned_scan(state)
        reads = [call.args[0] for call in status.call_args_list]
    result.update(first=first, after_first=after_first, second=second, after_second=after_second,
                  fresh_pass=[third, fourth], process_status_pids=reads,
                  iterator_opens=len(opens), iterator_closes=len(closes),
                  owned_entry_yield_count=yielded.count("9000"),
                  owned_stat_still_exists=(own / "stat").exists(),
                  counterexample_confirmed=(9000 not in reads and all(not page["processes"] for page in (first,second,third,fourth))
                                           and yielded.count("9000")==2))
result["source_after_sha256"] = hashlib.sha256(SOURCE.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
result["ended_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
result["collector_exit_code"] = 0 if result["counterexample_confirmed"] else 1
output=OUT / "cursor-boundary-counterexample-result.json"
assert not output.exists()
output.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(result["collector_exit_code"])
